```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(xml2)
```

```{r}
psychology = "psychology"
arxiv <- GET("http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:'psychology'")

status_code(arxiv)
```

```{r}
xml_data <- read_xml(arxiv)
xml_ns_strip(xml_data)
titles <- xml_text(xml_find_all(xml_data, ".//title"))
titles
```
```{r}
dates <- xml_text(xml_find_all(xml_data, ".//published"))
dates
```
```{r}
df <- data.frame(titles = titles[-1], dates = dates)
df
```
